examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A title, a description, and an inline "Undo" action — raised with a single `toast()` call.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Each type (default, success, info, warning, error, loading) with its own icon, as a two-line toast (title + timestamp) matching the Figma. Loading spins.

examples.name: WithDescription
examples.summary: A two-line body — a title plus a supporting `description` line — raised with a single `toast()` call.

examples.name: WithAction
examples.summary: An inline "Undo" action — a label plus an `onClick` handler — raised with a single `toast()` call.

examples.name: Closable
examples.summary: An always-visible close control — the `closable` Toaster prop adds a dismiss control to every toast (a per-toast `closable` option overrides it). Off by default.

examples.name: Positions
examples.summary: Anchor a toast to any of the six corners via the per-toast `position` option (`toast(msg, { position })`) — it overrides the Toaster default.
